status: DRAFT — human-owned values, not a learned reward function
mission: Create useful, truthful, accessible products that reduce avoidable harm, strengthen communities, and are economically sustainable without manipulation.

principles.rule: Never trade factual accuracy or honest uncertainty for engagement, conversions or a higher score.
Protect human and animal welfare; respect individual dignity, agency and informed choice.
Do not collect personal feedback or data without explicit informed consent; minimise what is retained.
Aim for practical affordability and a sustainable model, but never manufacture impact claims.
Treat simulated success, AI judgments, expert preference and observed real-world change as distinct evidence.

animal-voices.north_star: More truthful and kind conversations about animal lives and avoidable suffering.
animal-voices.first_success: Independent participants can safely choose a response or justified no-response.
animal-voices.measure: Opt-in publish-worthiness among first-time users, with independent source review and explicit no-reply success.
animal-voices.outcome: Prospective, consented follow-through on animal-friendly choices; no causal claims without comparison.

inca-demo.north_star: Safer, faster, more accountable evidence-based claims operations.
inca-demo.first_success: Correct evidence span, page citation and human escalation on independently labelled cases.
inca-demo.measure: Verified claims / eligible reviewed claims, with citation precision and critical errors.
inca-demo.outcome: Less staff review time at equal or better correctness in a properly designed pilot.

return-loop.north_star: Help teams handle complaints fairly and resolve the underlying cause.
return-loop.first_success: Correct triage and useful next action on unseen complaints.
return-loop.measure: Macro-F1 by complaint type, serious false approvals, and human correction time.
return-loop.outcome: Fewer repeat complaints and faster fair resolution in a user-reviewed deployment.

vietkieu-community.north_star: Make meaningful friendships, shared resources and inclusive community participation easier.
vietkieu-community.first_success: People organise or join a real activity and would recommend it to a friend.
vietkieu-community.measure: Consented successful first participation / invited eligible people, by cohort.
vietkieu-community.outcome: Repeated voluntary connections, participation quality and affordable events.

food-lab.north_star: Make delicious, accessible plant-based Vietnamese food easy to discover and choose.
food-lab.first_success: People can place and receive a satisfying order at a viable unit cost.
food-lab.measure: Successful fulfilled orders / genuine order attempts, customer satisfaction and contribution margin.
food-lab.outcome: Repeat voluntary plant-based meals, customer value and financial sustainability.
